title: 10-year Treasury yield climbs back to 5% after Fed hikes rates, Warsh highlights inflation risks
summary_full: The 10-year yield moved above the 5% mark after a Federal Reserve rate increase and comments from Chairman Kevin Warsh highlighting persistent inflation risks.
summary_public: The 10-year yield moved above the 5% mark after a Federal Reserve rate increase and comments from Chairman Kevin Warsh highlighting persistent inflation risks.
